sentences.en: We must try to preserve the remains of ancient civilizations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须努力保护古代文明的遗迹。

sentences.en: The saddest part of the story remains to be told.
sentences.zh: 故事中最悲伤的部分仍然待讲述。

sentences.en: You can still see the remains of the fortress there.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以看到那座堡垒的残骸。

senses.zh: 遗体，遗骸；遗迹，遗存；剩余物，残余
仍然是，依然是；留下，剩下
